description.from: Parked follow-up for replacing AWS S3 Vectors in local MVP mode. MinIO handles ordinary object storage, but vector indexing/search needs a separate local provider, likely Chroma for the first MVP proof.
description.to: Replace AWS S3 Vectors in local MVP mode using Qdrant as the local provider for vector indexing/search while keeping AWS mode unchanged. Scope includes provider abstraction, env/config wiring, local compose runtime, and smoke proof for VectorTopicMemory end-to-end behavior.
